evidence.title: Agentcard - YC company profile
evidence.excerpt: TL;DR Buying online with agents is hard. You can't share your card with your agent, browser automations are broken and slow, and most checkout pages block agents, mistaking them for bots. Agentcard gives companies a solution for storing users' credit cards and completing checkout pages with a 99% success rate. Ask: building an agent that buys things on behalf of your users? send us a msg: founders@agentcard.sh Problem Companies building personal AI assistants want to give their users a simple way to buy using agents. Today, they need to 1) create browser automations to navigate online stores, 2) store users' cards, and 3) complete checkout pages. None of this is their main product. And current solutions don't work: agentic protocols for storing cards have an 8% card acceptance rate (i.e., most of your cards don't work) and are US-only; agentic browsers get blocked when trying to complete a checkout page; companies store cards without being PCI compliant; and, finally, any dispute becomes a problem for the merchant. Our solution How it works Team
